guidelines.title: Google XYZ Bullet Formula
guidelines.summary: Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z].
guidelines.explanation: Every bullet should start with an action verb describing what was accomplished, provide an objective metric of scale or improvement, and explain the technical tool or strategy utilized.
guidelines.good_example: Reduced API response times by 42% (from 350ms to 200ms) across 15 endpoints by implementing Redis caching and optimizing PostgreSQL query execution plans.
guidelines.bad_example: Responsible for working on backend APIs and making queries faster.

guidelines.title: Impact Metric Dimensions
guidelines.summary: Quantify via Performance, Scale, Money, or Quality.
guidelines.explanation: Good resume metrics fit into four buckets: 1) Performance (latency, throughput, load time), 2) Scale (users, requests/sec, data size in GB/TB), 3) Financial/Time ($ saved, hours automated), 4) Reliability/Quality (test coverage %, error rate reduction, uptime SLA).

guidelines.title: Avoiding Generic & AI-Sounding Phrasing
guidelines.summary: Replace grandiose buzzwords with concrete engineering specifics.
guidelines.explanation: Phrases like 'spearheaded pivotal initiatives' or 'leveraged cutting-edge paradigms' sound hollow and generic. State specifically what tool was written, what bug was fixed, or what design decision was made.
